about.description: Mastering digital logic, CMOS fundamentals, and netlist-to-GDSII ASIC flows. I design high-performance physical chip layouts, program ESP32 firmware, and develop backend systems to connect the physical and digital domains.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Rushank**. I am an Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) student specializing in hardware optimization and embedded systems.

Grounded in digital logic design, CMOS fundamentals, and hardware description concepts, I study EDA tools and microcontroller architectures. Currently in my 4th Semester (Expected graduation 2028) at VTU (BLDEA’s V.P. Dr. P.G.H. College of Engineering & Technology).

Alongside semiconductor engineering, I bridge physical hardware structures with intelligent software architectures — programming ESP32/Arduino microcontrollers, developing high-performance Python/Django backends, and building interactive web interfaces with precision and reliable execution.

projects.title: Drowsiness Detection System
projects.description:
Developed a safety-focused hardware-software prototype on an RC Car platform to prevent driver fatigue incidents.

Deployed Hugging Face vision models on a Python backend with real-time video stream processing. Integrated immediate physical alerting mechanisms (buzzer and motor cut-off ignition switch) via Arduino microcontroller over serial communication.

projects.title: Autonomous Maze-Solving Robot
projects.description:
Assembled and programmed a fully functional autonomous maze-solving robot in a strict 12-hour build fest.

Designed path-detection infrared (IR) sensor arrays and coded maze navigation logic with a tuned PID control loop in C++ on an Arduino platform for fast, real-time error correction and cornering.

projects.title: Reliable ESP32 Data Logger & OTA
projects.description:
An industrial-grade, fault-tolerant ESP32 IoT telemetry platform engineered with ESP-IDF v5.4 and FreeRTOS dual-core task isolation.

Features real-time microsecond bit-banging on Core 1, LittleFS circular store-and-forward flash buffer, Ubidots REST cloud telemetry with CRC-16 checksums, and a secure dual-partition (ping-pong) HTTPS Over-The-Air firmware upgrade engine with mbedTLS encryption and anti-rollback protection.

roadmap.description: Completed Secondary School (Class X) under CBSE Curriculum at Kendriya Vidyalaya, Vijayapura with 82.5%, building strong analytical foundations in science and mathematics.
Completed Pre-University Course (PUC - PCM) at JSS Pre-University College, Mysuru with a 90% score, sharpening calculus, physics, and computational thinking.

Pursuing Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Electronics & Communication Engineering at BLDEA's V.P. Dr. P.G.H. CET, VTU. Focusing on Digital System Design, Microcontrollers (ESP32/Arduino), and C/C++ embedded programming.
